purpose: Static alignment to supplied reference screenshots; not live-play measurement

method.crop: Manually bound the visible puzzle bodies, excluding app chrome, marketing text and surrounding whitespace. Bounds use Pillow left/top inclusive, right/bottom exclusive coordinates.
method.width: Manually selected perpendicular cuts through straight tube segments. Count inclusive endpoints across the visible colored body plus dark edge; exclude detached cast shadow, head and bend. Allow about +/-2 source pixels at anti-aliased edges. Report samples, not a whole-image average.
method.normalization: sampleWidth / visiblePuzzleCropWidth * 360. Keep original aspect ratio; never stretch to a square.
method.headCount: Manual count of visible paired-eye heads in the supplied reference, with marked coordinates for review. It is a screenshot count, not an inference about all levels.
method.limits: No inferred logical grid, playable fill rate, input target width, difficulty, frame duration, sound or haptics. Promotional images may differ from live builds. Scaling does not equal a physical device test.
